description: This file defines the TaskbarItemService class in Java, which provides methods for managing taskbar items within desktop sessions, including listing, creating, updating, and deleting items, with external interactions via repositories and handling exceptions.

classes.name: TaskbarItemService
classes.description: A service class for managing taskbar items in desktop sessions, providing CRUD operations with session and window validation, converting entities to DTOs, and handling related exceptions.

methods.name: listItemsForSession
methods.description: Lists all taskbar items associated with a given session, ordered by their 'orderIndex'.

methods.name: createItem
methods.description: Creates a new taskbar item within a specified session, optionally linked to a window, and returns its DTO representation.

methods.name: updateItem
methods.description: Updates an existing taskbar item's properties, ensuring it belongs to the specified session, and returns the updated DTO.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes a taskbar item from a session after validating its association.

methods.name: ensureSessionExists
methods.description: Checks if a session exists; throws exception if not.

methods.name: toDto
methods.description: Converts a TaskbarItem entity to its DTO representation for external use.
